learning_outcomes.text: Establishes relationships between atoms, molecules, compound structures and chemical bonding
Being able to comprehend the periodic table and element properties and choose awareness.
Understand the properties of liquids, solids, gases and intermolecular forces and apply them to the relevant field.
Solve problems based on stoichiometry by recognizing chemical reactions.
Explains the relationship between solubility and solution. Makes calculations related to solution concentrations.
Defines the laws of chemistry and the basic concepts in chemistry.
Explains chemical speed and its factors and solves speed calculation problems
Be able to distinguish between Chemical Equilibrium and Solubility Equilibrium.
Describe the general properties of acids and bases and calculate pH.

syllabus_topics: Electron Structure of Atoms and the Periodic System
Types of chemical reactions and calculations
Colligative properties in solutions and calculation of melting boiling temperature
Properties of gases and gas laws
Pressure measurement in combined vessels and real gases
General properties of acids and bases, neutralization and titration
